data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'nāl', meaning 'wave' or 'graceful'. In Islamic culture, Nelee represents the gentle, flowing nature of the waves in the sea, reminding us of Allah's infinite mercy and love. The name Nelee carries the meaning “Graceful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nelee usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
